text: {"reconstruction":5,"feasibility":4,"rationale":"The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (From/To with suggestion picks, date, Passengers/Class with counts and cabin, Confirm, Show flights, then price plus Select fare for each leg), and its parameters cover all the true inputs, with passengers split into adult/child/infant counts and a fare_choice added; feasibility loses a point for small vague spots like the 'or pick it from Explore' alternative, 'choose cabin if needed', and an unclear way to identify the fare per leg."}

data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (From/To with suggestion picks, date, Passengers/Class with counts and cabin, Confirm, Show flights, then price plus Select fare for each leg), and its parameters cover all the true inputs, with passengers split into adult/child/infant counts and a fare_choice added; feasibility loses a point for small vague spots like the 'or pick it from Explore' alternative, 'choose cabin if needed', and an unclear way to identify the fare per leg.
